players.product: lithium-ion cells for data-center BBUs (battery back-up units) and high-power UPS / ESS battery modules for AI loads

quarterly_data.quarter: Samsung SDI press release: SAMSUNG SDI Unveils Innovative Battery Solutions for AI (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI data-center battery lineup shown at DCWA 2026 (Singapore): the company says its UPS solution recently became the first in the world to satisfy all requirements of UL Solutions' Indoor Large Scale Fire Test (Indoor LSFT); its BBU lineup includes a high-power, high-capacity 21700 nickel-based cylindrical battery with a bottom-vent design; it unveiled a cylindrical LFP battery for the first time (based on proprietary structural technology, with higher power output and capacity); and prismatic LFP batteries for its Samsung Battery Box (SBB) 2.0 ESS solution. No availability dates were given.
